changes: YouTube login me Cancel button — ghalat browser tab khul jaye to Cancel dabao, port foran free hoga aur dobara Connect kar sako ge (5 minute ka intezar nahi).
Google login me ab har dafa account chunne ka option ayega, taake ghalat account auto-use na ho.
YouTube tab ab Dashboard ke neeche, Accounts ke upar hai.
Library ke buttons, dropdowns aur search box ki height aik jaisi kar di gayi hai — sab aik seedhi line me nazar ayenge.
Manager se YouTube OFF karne par app YouTube tab kholte hi server se taaza license lega aur lock dikhayega; background check ab har 1 ghante hoga.
notes: Naya version v1.6.9 tayyar hai (aap ke paas v1.6.8 hai). YouTube login me Cancel, account chunne ka option, YouTube tab ki nayi jagah, Library buttons ki seedhi alignment aur License OFF ka foran asar.
